title: Brainstem Navigator · brainstem and diencephalic source regions

images.name: Source 7 T group-average diffusion fractional anisotropy

units_evidence: Source Readme declares 1 mm isotropic grids; all selected headers declare millimetres.

space.name: Brainstem Navigator supplied MNI grid
space.reference: Brainstem Navigator 1.0 Readme and original BIlab template headers
space.correspondence: The publisher supplies these independent masks, probabilities and BIlab T2-weighted/FA group averages in the same MNI grid. Exact grids are verified. The project performs no registration or resampling and establishes no new correspondence to other MNI atlas packages.

sources.title: Brainstem Navigator: normal brainstem and diencephalic regions with BIlab MRI templates
sources.citation: Bianciardi et al. 2015, doi:10.1089/brain.2015.0347; Bianciardi et al. 2018, doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2017.04.070; Garcia-Gomar et al. 2019, doi:10.3389/fnins.2019.00764; Singh et al. 2020, doi:10.3389/fnins.2019.01425; Singh et al. 2021, doi:10.1089/brain.2020.0975; Garcia-Gomar et al. 2022 (online 2021), doi:10.1002/mds.28895. Retain the source copyright and acknowledgments.
sources.license_name: Brainstem Navigator non-commercial research terms; no external distribution of files or derived information

mask_rule.source: Delivered labels_thresholded_binary_0.35; exact agreement with the inclusive source probability threshold is required.

probability_interpretation: Population-template spatial overlap of source nucleus delineations from twelve healthy adults. Values are not an individual tissue probability, clinical confidence or proof of a microscopic boundary.
probability_derivation: The source authors delineated and transformed subject labels to the supplied template. This package preserves the delivered scalar probability values without additional transforms, resampling, mirroring or interpolation.
region_evidence: Source population-template delineation with an independent delivered binary navigation mask. The surface is computed at the half-voxel boundary of that mask; it is not a directly observed tissue surface.
region_notes: Each source region remains independent; simultaneous memberships are preserved and are not resolved by winner-take-all labeling.
The delivered binary navigation mask uses an inclusive 0.35 probability threshold. Full source probabilities below this boundary remain available.
BIlab MRI templates cover part of the brain and omit some regions, including the temporal lobes. Outside coverage is not evidence of absent anatomy.
Native 1 mm sampling and population averaging limit small-structure interpretation. No geometric smoothing or microscopic detail is added.
Source collections contain both whole nuclei and delivered subdivisions. Catalogue entry counts are not counts of independent anatomical entities.
Compound source regions remain compound. No separation of microscopic nuclei, individual cranial nerve origins or functional connections is inferred.

acquisition: Run neuroimage acquire brainstem_navigator_mni --data-root <existing-data-root>. Reuse the verified official archive and its selected members.

archives.hash_basis: SHA256 pinned from the verified local official archive; not a publisher signature

scope_notes: All 76 delivered MNI brainstem fields and all 10 delivered MNI diencephalic fields are retained as independent source probabilities and masks.
The paired BIlab images have partial brain coverage. No other-space registration or missing image detail is synthesized.
Only normal-source atlas fields are imported. Clinical-cohort images and disease connectivity results in cited application studies are outside scope.
